agent_explanation: Two heavy bodies (~17,18 Msun, G~4.73) on head-on orbits undergo deep close encounter (0.39->0.35 separation at steps 22-23). Adaptive substeps (13-16 per step) insufficient for strong acceleration/velocity; leapfrog phase error injects energy: -483.5 at step22 to -577.4 at step23 to -620.4 at step24. Smaller dt removes failure, confirming integrator-accuracy cause, not force-model error. Momentum remains conserved.
